summary: Iter 12 review: Aprovechamientos backend feature 100% green (10/10 new pytest tests + 21/21 regression = 31/31). Backend: /cutting/{id}/complete handles is_aprovechamiento=true correctly (no stock deduction, doc in db.aprovechamientos, response.aprovechamientos populated); mixed parts (aprov + normal) deduct only the non-aprov part; GET /api/aprovechamientos returns list sorted DESC by created_at with required fields and no _id leak; /api/cutting/pending now includes part_percentages per cutting_service (empty {} when none); extended filter matches polarizado/3m/crystalline/mixto services. FRONTEND /cutting Completar Corte: dialog renders 9 part-largo-<id> + 9 part-ancho-<id> + 9 part-aprov-<id>; largo/ancho options span 1..350 (verified first=1, last=350, total=351 incl. empty placeholder); checkbox part-aprov-<id> toggles purple background + 'Registrado en base de aprovechamientos' info text; part-pct badge present in code (verified earlier in iter11) but not rendered on legacy seed orders (no part_percentages set). FRONTEND BUG FOUND: largo/ancho selects reset to empty after selection because the parse regex /^(\d+)\s*x\s*(\d+)/ only matches when BOTH dimensions are present in partMeasurements; selecting only largo stores '120 cm' which doesn't reparse → both selects reset to '' on next render; same for ancho-only. Even sequential largo→ancho selection fails because the second onChange's closure sees the post-reset empty largo. UX BROKEN. Recommend storing largo/ancho as separate fields in state OR loosening regex to capture partial values.

ui_bugs.issue: Largo/Ancho selects RESET to empty after the user picks a value. Root cause at L604-611: const measureMatch = String(measureRaw).match(/^(\d+)\s*x\s*(\d+)/i); only matches '120x60' shape. When user picks only largo, updateMeasure stores '120 cm' (partial branch) — on next render the regex returns null → largo='' AND ancho='' → controlled select displays placeholder. Sequential selection ALSO fails: after picking largo (state='120 cm'), the next render shows largo=''; when user picks ancho the closure sees newLargo='' so updateMeasure stores ''. Net effect: it is impossible to set a complete measurement via the UI. CRITICAL UX BLOCKER for the iter12 feature.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Today 2026-06-04. Iter12 backend = 31/31 green. The ONE outstanding issue is a UX-breaking frontend bug in CuttingView.jsx where partial largo OR ancho selection resets both selects to empty (regex /^(\d+)\s*x\s*(\d+)/ only matches complete dimensions). Reproduce: open /cutting as corte role, click any 'Completar Corte', pick part-largo-panoramico=120 then check the select.value — it will be '' again. Fix scope: store largo/ancho independently or relax the regex. After fix, retest by simulating a complete measurement entry, then verify partMeasurements payload reaches backend on submit. Reusable helpers in test_iteration12_features.py: _create_rollo, _drive_to_en_corte (with optional part_percentages and service_name).
rca of the issue: Frontend bug: CuttingView.jsx derives largo/ancho on every render from a single combined string via /^(\d+)\s*x\s*(\d+)/. Partial values produced by updateMeasure ('120 cm' or '' for ancho-only) do NOT match this regex, so the derived largo/ancho are both '' on re-render. Controlled <select value={largo}> then snaps back to the empty option, wiping the user's choice. Sequential largo->ancho also fails because the second onChange's closure has already captured the post-reset largo=''. Mitigation: (a) keep two independent state maps partLargoMap[part.id]/partAnchoMap[part.id]; or (b) store partial strings that the regex can parse ('120x' / 'x60'); or (c) keep array of [largo, ancho] in partMeasurements[part.id].
